description: Scanned document body with vector footer containing page numbers and metadata

source.generation_method: Generated via tests/fixtures/hybrid/hybrid-005-generator.py using raw PDF construction: scanned document body (1-bit grayscale image XObject, top 90%) with vector footer overlay (9pt Helvetica, bottom 10%) containing page numbers, confidentiality notice, and horizontal divider line

hybrid_behavior.vector_regions: Page header (28pt Helvetica, top ~5%) and footer region (9pt Helvetica with page numbers and confidentiality notice, bottom ~10%) with horizontal divider line
hybrid_behavior.scanned_regions: Document body (1-bit grayscale image XObject, top 90%) with text line pattern throughout
hybrid_behavior.overlap_description: Scanned body in top 90%, vector footer in bottom 10% with minimal boundary overlap at transition

grid_cell_coverage.hybrid_cell_locations: Bottom row (row 7) contains both scanned body content above and vector footer elements, creating boundary hybrid cells

classification_challenges: Similar to hybrid-001 (vertical stack) but with vector content at bottom instead of top, testing symmetry of detection
Footer elements are small and may be missed by classifier if scan covers too much of page
Page numbers in footer may be mistaken for OCR artifacts rather than substantive vector content
Horizontal divider line between body and footer creates additional vector/scanned boundary complexity
Tests whether classifier detects hybrid content when vector region is at page bottom rather than top
test_focus: Footer extraction precision (vector page numbers and notices)
Boundary detection accuracy between scanned body and vector footer
Classification symmetry with top-header (hybrid-001) vs bottom-footer patterns
Small vector region detection when dominated by large scanned region
Horizontal line element handling in merge rules
notes: Synthetic fixture complementing hybrid-001 by testing vertical stack pattern with vector content at bottom instead of top. This tests classifier symmetry and footer extraction precision. The fixture includes a horizontal divider line between body and footer, which adds complexity to the boundary detection. Footer contains page numbers and confidentiality notices, testing whether small vector regions are correctly identified when dominated by large scanned content areas.
